propositions: SHA-drift invalidation currently triggers on ANY code change when file_impact is undeclared, causing 21% of re-reviews on byte-identical material; scoping this fail-safe to the observed read-set and blast-radius entries reduces false positives while preserving fail-closed semantics

The signed manifest must record normalized, deduplicated read-set paths (tool=read_file only, repo-relative POSIX form, existing regular files only) as read-path entries with a read-set marker when observed, absent otherwise; tampered read-sets must fail verification

Read-set scoping applies only when all preconditions hold: pre-existing dependency set is empty, no container poison rule applies, scope is undeclared (not authenticated none), and a read-set was recorded; it composes read-set with blast-radius entries (criteria_routing.json, rebar.toml, criteria/**, reviewers/*.md, workflow/gates/**) using membership-digest globs
An already-scoped set, poisoned container, or authenticated-none scope must never gain blast-radius entries, to avoid widening scope or re-enabling invalidation on previously exempt attestations

Unverifiable read-set, pre-change attestations lacking the field, or expansion failure fall back to invalidate-on-any-change (full HEAD re-hash); three code paths must dispatch through hash_dep_entry to handle globs consistently

The currency-basis field (file_impact | read-set | fail-safe) must be recorded in the signed manifest, reported by plan_review_status, and displayed in --status text and JSON output; ADR-0002 must document the read-set field, composition rule, and membership digest
